prerequisites: Elementary knowledge of Automatic Control is desirable, though not essential.
Basic notions of Linear Algebra are advisable.
Basic notions of Differential and Integral Calculus are advisable.
Basic notions of Numerical Methods are advisable.
Basic notions of Electrical Technology are advisable.
Basic notions of Computer Fundamentals are advisable.

learning_outcomes.text: Update fundamental knowledge in topics related to the control of mechatronic applications.
Utilize mathematical tools that allow them to analyze and solve mechatronic applications.
Update fundamental knowledge in structured programming.
Program computer-aided systems for the control of mechatronic systems.

syllabus_topics: MMECAT03-C-003 Computers and Programming (6.0 ECTS cr.)
MMECAT03-1-002 Mechatronic Systems of One Degree of Freedom (4.0 ECTS cr.)
assessment_rules: To pass "Automatic Control I", students must pass both local master's subjects: "Computers and Programming" (CyP) and "Mechatronic Systems of One Degree of Freedom" (1GdL). The final grade for "Automatic Control I" is calculated as 0.75 * CyP + 0.25 * 1GdL. If the requirement to pass both local courses is not met, the final grade will be "FAIL", and the numerical qualification will be the weighted average or 4.0 (whichever is lower). If a student does not attend all defined exams in the local subjects, their final grade will be “Not Presented (NP)” or FAIL depending on the exams attended, with participation in at least 50% of activities obliging a grade.
